text:
alex: Heads up — billing / console shows a weird spike for org-ord-42 around 10:12 UTC. One API call that triggered a tool call got counted as ~2x the tokens we see in the runtime logs.
priya: Do you have the request id? I can pull the ledger entries.
alex: req=ra_9f8c. Runtime log shows: ```tokens: {prompt: 130, completion: 210, tool_call: 48} total=388``` Console usage shows ~760 for the same time window.
miguel: Interesting. Could be retries getting attributed twice or tool_call tokens being added to both prompt and completion buckets downstream. We recently changed how tool calls are serialized in the gateway.
dana: Which path did this request go through — hosted API or dedicated routing? That affects which billing pipeline tags the pieces.
alex: Hosted -> routed to ded_pool_A -> runtime v2.3.1. No client-side retries. The client sent one request, runtime logs only one completion. But the quota ledger has two entries: one labeled prompt tokens and one labeled completion tokens that both include the tool_call amount.
priya: Billing ledger prints attached: ```ledger_line: {ts:1772104330, type:completion, tokens:258, note: "req=ra_9f8c"} ledger_line: {ts:1772104331, type:prompt, tokens:502, note: "req=ra_9f8c"}``` That prompt line looks inflated.
miguel: I bet the gateway is replaying the tool payload as a nested prompt for the selector service during routing, and the billing hook is counting both the original prompt and the selector prompt. That would duplicate the tool_call tokens.
dana: If true, we should add dedup keys to billing events: use request id + stage. Does the ledger currently include stage?
billing-bot: Automated check: ingress_hook and post_response_hook both emitted token events for req=ra_9f8c. Duplicate events detected (same request id, different stage). Suggested mitigation: collapse by request_id when stage != final.
priya: For short-term, we can run a backfill to fix billing for that org, but we need to prevent recurrence. Is there a small runtime change (runtime or gateway) to avoid emitting tool_call tokens twice?
miguel: Quick fix: update gateway to tag internal selector calls with header X-Internal-Stage and have billing ignore token events where X-Internal-Stage!=final. I'll open a PR.
dana: UX note — console should show a tooltip explaining transient reconciliations vs reconciled usage so SREs don't freak. Also add a delta column in the per-request view for tokens emitted vs tokens billed.
alex: For completeness: the duplicated amount equals the tool_call tokens (48) + ~20 token framing difference = ~70, which matches spike. So seems consistent.
priya: I'll queue the backfill with finance for org-ord-42 after the patch. Miguel, can you triage PR for fast path?
miguel: Yup, PR in a few hours. Assigning to eng-platform to review.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026, severity: low, owner: miguel, notes: duplicate token events from gateway.
dana: Also capture telemetry change — add label "billing_event_source" with values {gateway, runtime, selector} so we can aggregate without guessing.
priya: Thanks all. Keep threads short; link any PRs and DB update job ids here.
miguel: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/-/merge_requests/4052 (WIP)
alex: I'll monitor console for anomalies once the tag filter is out. :thumbsup:
